description: Creates an Amazon Redshift Query Editor (QEV2) IAM Identity Center application.

Tag.description: A tag consisting of a name/value pair for a resource.

Key.description: The key, or name, for the resource tag.

Value.description: The value for the resource tag.

IdcInstanceArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the IAM Identity Center instance used to create the Amazon Redshift Query Editor (QEV2) managed application.

Qev2IdcApplicationName.description: The name of the Amazon Redshift Query Editor (QEV2) application in IAM Identity Center.

IdcDisplayName.description: The display name for the Amazon Redshift Query Editor (QEV2) IAM Identity Center application. It appears in the console.

Qev2IdcApplicationArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the Amazon Redshift Query Editor (QEV2) application that integrates with IAM Identity Center.

IdcManagedApplicationArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the Amazon Redshift Query Editor (QEV2) IAM Identity Center managed application.

IdcOnboardStatus.description: The onboarding status for the Amazon Redshift Query Editor (QEV2) IAM Identity Center application.

Tags.description: A list of tags associated with the application. Tags are key-value pairs that you can use to organize and identify your resources.
